messages:
Joanne: quick heads-up 12px toolbar on dashboard feels visually unbalanced. primary CTA reads too heavy next to the ghost at 320px. attached: https://img.redwood.dev/u/toolbar-snap.png
Eli: I see it. the primary's optical weight is bigger because of padding + border contrast. can we try shrinking horizontal padding first?
Kevin: shrinking padding helps, but watch for hit target. maybe reduce padding by 4px and drop font-weight from 600 -> 500 for systems without variable fonts.
Samir: also noticed toasts are interrupting VoiceOver on success flows. currently all toasts use assertive. propose mapping: error=assertive, success/info=polite.
Design Bot: accessibility-scan: current toast role="status" + aria-live="assertive" flagged. recommendation: aria-live by intent and add runtime trimming for long messages. contrast: ghost button text ratio 4.0:1 on surface at small sizes (borderline).
Joanne: acceptance criteria: 1) toolbar primary not visually heavier than ghost at small breakpoint, 2) toasts use polite for non-errors, 3) VO reads trimmed previews ~100-120 chars, with link to full details.
Eli: quick CSS I pushed to branch `design/toolbar-cta-compact` with vars to experiment:
```
:root {
  --btn-primary-padding-x: 12px; /* was 16 */
  --btn-primary-font-weight: 500; /* fallback if variable font unavailable */
  --space-toast-vertical: 10px; /* mobile compact stack */
}
```
Kevin: added PR for aria mapping and a small JS helper to truncate for screen readers. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/commit/cde789. includes tests asserting aria-live for error vs info.
Samir: ran quick mobile A/B: reduced padding + weight tweak improves perceived balance. toast stack with 10px vertical spacing less intrusive. gif: https://img.redwood.dev/u/toast-compact.gif
Joanne: nice work. QA checklist for merge: - Error toasts announce assertive - Info/success polite - Toast VO preview <=120 chars - Toolbar visual check at 320px passes optical parity - Ghost button contrast rechecked
Eli: I'll add the QA checklist to the PR and note token changes in tokens.md.
Design Bot: changelog reminder: update token `--btn-primary-padding-x` and `--space-toast-vertical`. visual-regression: header shift 1-3px on mobile within tolerance.
Joanne: scheduled 15m sync tomorrow to review results. if all green we'll merge after sync. thanks :+1:
